prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated in a minimalist concrete stairwell with direct flash.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with dark espresso-brown slightly wavy hair, natural pores and skin texture, defined brows, deep brown eyes, and a self-assured direct gaze. She wears a white structured cotton poplin shirt, a tailored gray Prince of Wales check blazer, a matching plaid lower garment, a deep-crimson silk satin necktie, and glossy black nail lacquer. Preserve the barefoot styling visible in the reference.
composition_elements: Subject crouched and seated on concrete stair steps with knees raised and feet visible, leaning against a white plastered stairwell wall.
One hand rests on the step while the other arm is relaxed near the blazer; maintain the editorial compact pose and direct gaze.
White plaster, concrete tread, and terracotta stair tiles create a restrained architectural background.
Keep plaid geometry, tie, shirt collar, black manicure and pedicure, and natural hand anatomy clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard direct on-camera flash with crisp subject shadow on the white plaster, high contrast, cool-neutral highlights, and an editorial raw snapshot atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 vertical portrait, 35mm full-frame lens at f/8, ISO 100, 1/200s, deep focus across subject and wall, realistic wool-blend, cotton, concrete, skin, and tile texture, no text or watermark.
